# webtables/funcref

> Function value: its index in the program's function table, from 1.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/funcref.pkg)

[program](program.md) lists every function used as a value in a table,
which [callfn](callfn.md) calls through with `call_indirect`; 0 is left
for `null`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.const {index})
```
